title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Recurrence
overview: Decades ago, two people took drastic measures to ensure their escape from a galaxy engulfed by war. Unfortunately, the past has finally caught up to them.

title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Alegium
overview: Chirico doesn’t care what Titania wants nor that the COMPLANT is falling apart around them. Fyana is the only person who matters and Chirico won’t stop until he gets her back.

title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Pilgrimage
overview: Cardinal Montwell uses a recent accomplishment as leverage. Titania seeks out someone intimately familiar with Chirico’s history.

title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: Critical
overview: The deliberations take a shocking turn with the delivery of unexpected news. Titania finally comes face to face with Fyana.

title: Brilliantly Shining Heresy: The Untouchable
overview: Chirico is coming for Fyana and woe be to anyone who stands in the way. The final confrontation between Chirico and Titania is approaching. Who will be left standing?
